source.reference: ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN NOT NULL and a non-concurrent CREATE INDEX taking ACCESS EXCLUSIVE / write locks on a populated table
source.upstream_licence: n/a — the defect is a SQL statement shape, not code

defect: 0007 adds a NOT NULL column with no default and no backfill, then builds an index without CONCURRENTLY. Against a populated users table the first statement fails outright and the second blocks writes for the duration.
why_it_is_hard: Migrations in this repository run against a scratch database created empty for each test run, so both statements succeed instantly and the migration check is green. The hazard needs rows, which no check here has.
